modelNotes: Points Board 1.3 reads from nba_core.json, nba_minutes_engine.json, and nba_usage_engine.json.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Sengun (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
injury.detail: Sengun has a chance to return from a one-game absence with a back issue. If the star big man indeed gets back in the lineup, less playing time will be available at center for Tari Eason and Clint Capela.

injury.shortComment: Brown (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Knicks.
injury.detail: Brown is in danger of sitting out Friday's showdown with the defending champions, which is the front end of a back-to-back set. More pressure would fall on Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid and LeBron James if Brown is out, while Kentavious Caldwell-Pope would be the most likely choice to enter the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Nembhard (neck) is listed as probable for Friday's game against Miami.
injury.detail: Nembhard has been battling some lingering neck stiffness, though he's likely to play Friday. He's coming off an 18-point, 14-assist double-double in Wednesday's loss to Philadelphia and should continue taking on increased playmaking responsibilities in Tyrese Haliburton's (hamstring) stead.

injury.shortComment: Schroder (foot) is probable for Friday against the Wizards.
injury.detail: Schroder was previously listed as questionable, so he's trending in the right direction. Through five games, he's averaging 14.0 points, 4.6 assists, 4.0 rebounds and 1.0 three-pointers.

injury.shortComment: Marshall is questionable for Friday's game against the Rockets with an illness.
injury.detail: Marshall has a chance to return from a two-game absence Friday. Fewer minutes would be open for Zaccharie Risacher off the bench if Marshall is able to return.

injury.shortComment: Smith is questionable for Friday's game against Boston with a left finger sprain.
injury.detail: This is a new injury for Chicago's starting center, but he's considered day-to-day. If Smith is held out against Boston, the Bulls could lean more on Zach Collins.

injury.shortComment: Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Friday's game against the Heat.
injury.detail: The Pacers continue to monitor Nesmith's health while he works back from a hamstring injury. The sharpshooter has watched his minutes climb incrementally in each of his last three appearances, so it's possible Nesmith will be ready for a larger workload Friday.

injury.shortComment: Hachimura (quadriceps) is probable for Friday's game against Minnesota, per Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com.
injury.detail: Hachimura is set to return from a two-game absence with quadriceps soreness. Kobe Sanders is likely to revert back to a bench role Friday, and fewer minutes should be available to Gradey Dick as well.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (Achilles) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Charlotte.
injury.detail: Johnson was a late scratch prior to Wednesday's loss to Cleveland due to right Achilles tightness and could remain on the inactive list Friday. His absence would leave additional minutes available for guys like Bilal Coulibaly, Bub Carrington and Will Riley.

injury.shortComment: Williams (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against Golden State.
injury.detail: Williams started in each of the first four games of the regular season but was unable to play in Wednesday's 103-87 win over the Clippers due to a foot injury. Jake LaRavia would likely remain in the Lakers' starting five if Williams is not cleared to play Friday.

injury.shortComment: Santos (knee) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors.
injury.detail: Santos is expected to miss a second straight game while dealing with left knee tendinitis. If the 24-year-old forward remains sidelined, Georges Niang would likely continue seeing increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Clowney (illness) was downgraded to questionable for Friday's game versus Detroit, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
injury.detail: Clowney woke up under the weather and could be a game-time call Friday. He's played a modest role so far with 21.5 minutes per contest. If he's unable to play, the team could rely more on Josh Minott.

injury.shortComment: Ighodaro (oblique) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Denver.
injury.detail: Ighodaro hasn't played since Phoenix's regular-season opener due to a right oblique strain, though he's considered day-to-day ahead of Friday's contest. If the big man is cleared to return, Khaman Maluach and Duop Reath could see fewer minutes.

injury.shortComment: Joe (hip) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Brooklyn.
injury.detail: Joe has missed Detroit's last two games due to a right hip contusion, but his questionable designation suggests he could return Friday. The 27-year-old guard has appeared in three games this season, averaging 7.3 points in 13.9 minutes per contest. If Joe remains sidelined, Kevin Huerter, Ronald Holland and Javonte Green could continue seeing additional opportunities off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Awaka (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.
injury.detail: Awaka continues to battle a left ankle sprain. The rookie big man could go through morning shootaround and pregame warmups before the Bulls update his status.

injury.shortComment: Fontecchio (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Indiana.
injury.detail: Fontecchio is still under the weather and could hit the inactive list for a second straight game. However, his potential absence wouldn't cause any significant waves in the rotation.
